profile.name: PAWAN K. KUSHWAHA
profile.bio: I'm an Industrial & Product Designer who loves turning ideas into meaningful products and experiences. I design at the intersection of function, simplicity and human needs.

about.bioParagraph1: I'm Pawan Kumar Kushwaha, an Industrial and Product Designer specializing in physical-digital product development, precision CAD hardware, ergonomic furniture, and interactive experiences.
about.bioParagraph2: My approach bridges rigorous design engineering with tactile human satisfaction. From multi-axis CNC fabrication and additive tooling to seamless digital applications, I obsess over every joint, texture, radius, and curve.
about.toolsNote: Tools I use to turn ideas into products.
about.beyondDesc: Exploring new tools, making physical products, and learning through hands-on experiments.
about.heading: ABOUT ME
about.subtitle: Curiosity-driven Industrial & Product Designer based in India.

sections.title: Design Journey & Philosophy
sections.description: Over 4 years of continuous hands-on exploration developing production-grade products, ergonomic seating concepts, and tactile hardware.

sections.title: Technical Capabilities & Tooling
sections.description: SolidWorks, Autodesk Alias, CNC Machining, Additive Manufacturing (SLA/FDM), Figma, Swift, and physical bench modelmaking.

sections.title: Collaborations & Vision
sections.description: Partnering with innovative hardware startups, industrial studios, and visionary founders to turn ambitious concepts into market-ready realities.

about.skills: Industrial Design, Class-A Surfacing, SolidWorks, Fusion 360, CNC Milling, 3D Printing, Figma UI/UX, Ergonomics, DFM / Moldflow, Keyshot

projects.title: Wellness Journey
projects.shortDesc: I chose Snakes and Ladders as the foundation because it is a familiar game that children can understand quickly. By connecting its existing gameplay with health-related knowledge and physical activity, Wellness Journey makes learning about healthy habits more enjoyable and encourages children to play together.
projects.description: Wellness Journey is an interactive floor game designed to help children learn healthy habits while having fun and building social connections. The game combines physical activity, food awareness, and group interaction through a familiar Snakes and Ladders format, making it easy for children to understand and enjoy.
